agents.not-present: {agent} is not detected on this computer.
agents.scan-failed: Could not look for {agent} on this computer just now; nothing was changed. Try again.
agents.scan-failed-after: {agent} was changed, but Sidevoice could not check the result just now. Refresh to see its state.
agents.foreign: {agent} already has a Sidevoice registration that Sidevoice did not create; it was left unchanged.
agents.invalid: {agent} has an unreadable or malformed Sidevoice registration; it was left unchanged.
agents.registration-unknown: Sidevoice could not determine whether {agent} already has a Sidevoice registration.
agents.busy: Another host agent request is still running. Try again shortly.
agents.registration-not-confirmed: The Sidevoice registration for {agent} could not be confirmed after the command succeeded.
agents.manual.unsafe-command: No command line can be shown safely: the agent's CLI "{program}" is a batch file (or not known to be a program), and Windows' command interpreter would read characters in this line (& | < > ^ % ! or a double quote) as syntax. Install the CLI, or Sidevoice, at a path without them, or use the file or snippet setup.
service.busy: Another Sidevoice install or service command is under way ({detail}); nothing was changed. Try again when it has finished.
service.no-installation: Sidevoice is not installed on this computer: run `npx sidevoice install` first.
service.no-manager: This computer has no service manager for your user (launchd, or systemd --user), so Sidevoice cannot start at login here; it starts on demand when a conversation needs it.
service.unsafe-value: A value for the service definition ({what}) contains a control character; nothing was written.
service.definition-unsafe: A Sidevoice service definition or its directory is unsafe ({detail}); nothing was changed.
service.not-enabled: The service manager did not take the Sidevoice service for your next login ({detail}); it was not installed. Run `npx sidevoice service install` again once the manager can.
service.not-loaded: The Sidevoice service is installed but its service manager did not start it ({detail}). Start it with `npx sidevoice service start`, or install it again with `npx sidevoice service install`.
service.start-limit: The Sidevoice service failed too many times in a row and its service manager stopped trying ({detail}). Retry with `npx sidevoice service restart`.
service.executable-missing: The Sidevoice service points at a program that is not there any more ({detail}). Install Sidevoice again.
service.permission-denied: The Sidevoice service cannot run its program: permission denied ({detail}).
service.unload-failed: The service manager did not unload the Sidevoice service ({detail}); nothing was deleted.
service.node-stopped: Sidevoice was stopped by the person at this computer; run `npx sidevoice service start` to resume.
service.killed: Processes that did not stop in time were killed: {pids}.
service.linger-reason: Linux runs your services only while you are logged in. To keep Sidevoice running without a session (after a reboot, over SSH), the machine's owner can enable lingering for your user. It is a system setting, so Sidevoice does not change it:
service.login-no-service: Sidevoice has no login service on this computer, so there is nothing to start at login: install it with `npx sidevoice service install`.
service.login-failed: The service manager did not change whether Sidevoice starts at login ({detail}). Nothing was started or stopped; `npx sidevoice service login status` says where it stands.
service.login-incomplete: The Sidevoice login service is incomplete ({missing} is missing), so whether it starts at login was not changed. Repair it with `npx sidevoice service install`, then try again.
service.login-unknown: The service manager cannot tell whether {detail} starts at login, so Sidevoice did not start it: starting it could turn that on for good. Check `npx sidevoice service login status`, set it with `npx sidevoice service login on` or `off`, then start again.
service.login.off: Sidevoice does not start at login.
service.login.unknown: Whether Sidevoice starts at login is not known: it has no login service here, or the service manager cannot tell.
service.state.absent: Sidevoice is not installed on this computer.
service.state.not-installed: Sidevoice is installed but does not start at login (no service). Enable it with `npx sidevoice service install`.
service.state.stopped-by-person: Sidevoice is stopped until you start it (`npx sidevoice service start`) or log in again.
service.state.backoff: The Sidevoice core failed and its service manager is starting it again.
service.state.failed: The Sidevoice core failed and is not started again by itself: `npx sidevoice service restart` tries again.
service.state.service-failed: The Sidevoice service is not running.
not-loaded: The service manager has not loaded the core's job.
start-limit: The core's job failed too many times in a row and its service manager stopped trying.
executable-missing: The core's job points at a program that is not there any more.
permission-denied: The core's job cannot run its program: permission denied.
node.stopped: Sidevoice is stopped on this computer: start it from the app or with `npx sidevoice service start`.
connector.not-started: The Sidevoice connector did not start.
connector.service-down: The Sidevoice connector is not answering ({detail}); its service manager runs it. See `npx sidevoice service status`, or retry with `npx sidevoice service restart`.
ready.timeout: The core did not become ready in time.
install.not-ready:
Sidevoice did not become ready within {seconds} s (the core writing its ready file {ready} and answering a health check, and the connector answering as this release).{seen} Service: {service}. Read the end of the core's output in {output}.
Next: run `npx sidevoice service status`.
identity.unreadable: The core could not read this machine's identity.
bind.port-in-use: The core's port is taken by another program.
import.missing-module: The core is missing a part it needs ({detail}).
launch.missing-executable: The core's program is not where it was installed ({detail}).
launch.permission: The core's program cannot be run: permission denied ({detail}).
bind.core-running: Another Sidevoice core is already running for this data directory.
connector.failed: Sidevoice could not complete the command: {detail}
pair-device.failed: No pairing code could be had from this machine's core: {detail}
core.package-missing: This Sidevoice package does not carry a core for this computer ({detail}). Install Sidevoice again.
core.package-mismatch: The core in this Sidevoice package is not the one the package lists ({detail}); nothing was installed. Install Sidevoice again.
install.verify-failed: Sidevoice {version} is installed but did not start ({cause}). See `npx sidevoice service status`, or run the install again.
install.rolled-back: Sidevoice {version} did not start ({cause}), so this computer is back on {previous}, which is running. Nothing of {version} was kept.
install.rollback-failed: Sidevoice {version} did not start ({cause}), and {previous}, put back in its place, did not start either ({back}). See `npx sidevoice service status`.
